fields.label: RVA citation CORRECTED
fields.value: 0x00469ad4 mov ebx,2 is NOT the substep count — it is inside FUN_00469aa0's contact-history shift. FUN_004709a0 has no time loop either (0x00470ab0 cmp ebp,2 is the retry cap; it is a 16-vehicle loop).

fields.label: The real loop, transcribed
fields.value: 0x00471106..0x00471141 inside FUN_00470c70: rem = min(remaining,0x32) as an INTEGER, then while (rem) { sub = min(rem,0x19); FUN_004709a0((float)sub); rem -= sub; }. 50 -> 25,25 is exactly 2. Ready to port in one edit, deliberately held until U-9179 closes.
